title: Core 002 pressure and paper check
alt_text: Three separate HB strokes increase from light to medium to firm. Below, a light unshaded book outline is drawn with a spare sheet under the drawing hand; the reverse of a page is held to angled daylight while fingertips check for possible raised tracks. The image shows the check, not its result.
caption: Compare the three HB marks, keep the book outline light, and check the back of your own page at an angle to the light.
